title: Spatial grid dirty flag вЂ” skip rebuild when cells haven't moved
details: Spatial hash grid in spatial.py is rebuilt every tick even when cells haven't moved more than CELL_SIZE/2. Add a dirty flag to skip unnecessary rebuilds.
notes: Added SpatialGrid class to spatial.py with dirty flag (threshold=CELL_SIZE/2=24px). is_dirty() checks position shifts + cell count changes. refresh() rebuilds only when dirty. In main.py: initialized grid_wrapper=SpatialGrid(cells) before main loop, replaced build_spatial_grid(cells) with grid_wrapper.refresh()+grid_wrapper.grid in Python fallback (else branch). build_spatial_grid() preserved for minimap/corpses. All tests passed.
